verdict.rationale: SigNoz's AI docs list a first-party use case titled "Investigate What Changed After a Deploy", which points directly at correlating regressions with deploys. That use case is only a title in the evidence, with no description of how the comparison works. Nothing shows dedicated release or change tracking: no deploy markers, no version tagging on charts, no ingestion of change events. missing for 10: documented release/deploy markers or change-event ingestion, configuration-change tracking, details of how deploy correlation actually works, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can correlate regressions with deploys and configuration changes via release or change tracking
